description: 5 exemplars (one German) + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-14 under road-to-account-surface-detector step 3.2, which wired the account-surface detector into this skill's AUTH area and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover the four outputs the skill's own Output section names — the go/no-go decision, the pre-merge checklist, the rollout plan with rollback criteria, the ops handoff — plus the prelaunch diagnostic report. Near-misses are the three neighbours its 'WHEN NOT to use' routes to: the public comms text (release-comms), a routine internal merge (finishing-a-development-branch), and a stakeholder conflict over the rollout (stakeholder-tradeoff). Counterexamples guard the words 'launch' and 'rollback' outside a release: starting a local dev server and reverting a database migration in development.

queries.q: are we ready to ship this release to production? give me a go or no-go
write the pre-merge launch checklist for the v3 release PR
draft the rollout plan and rollback criteria for the new billing flag
run a prelaunch diagnostic across auth, secrets and rollback before we go live
sind wir launch-ready für das Release morgen? mach mir den Ops-Handoff
write the release notes and the announcement post for v3
queries.note: the comms text itself, not the decision to ship → release-comms

queries.q: this internal refactor branch is done — merge it and clean up
queries.note: a routine merge that crosses no release boundary → finishing-a-development-branch

queries.q: sales wants the feature live Friday and support wants two more weeks — who wins?
queries.note: a stakeholder conflict over the rollout is settled first → stakeholder-tradeoff

queries.q: how do I launch the local dev server on a different port?
roll back the last migration on my local database
